name: YungShin Global Holding Corporation
summary: YungShin Global Holding Corporation, through its subsidiaries, engages in investing, manufacturing, and sale of medicines, veterinary drugs, agricultural chemicals, industrial medicines, and cosmetics. It is also involved in the sale of medicine; trade, investment, and other related businesses; import and export trading; and food manufacturing. The company operates in Taiwan, the United States, Mainland China, and Japan. YungShin Global Holding Corporation was founded in 1952 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.
